statements: Regulation 2 of the Common Agricultural Policy (Financing, Management and Monitoring) (Miscellaneous Amendments) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019 (SI 2019/763) amends Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013 insofar as it relates to the common organisation of the markets and rural development.

Regulation 2 of the Financing, Management and Monitoring of Direct Payments to Farmers (Amendment) Regulations 2020 (SI 2020/90) amends Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013 in so far as it relates to CAP direct payments.

Regulation (EU) No 1306/2013 was retained by two separate routes, the Direct Payments to Farmers (Legislative Continuity) Act 2020 for direct payments and the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 for the common organisation of the markets and rural development.
The Agriculture (Retained EU Law and Data) (Scotland) Act 2020 confers power on the Scottish Ministers to modify the retained Regulation as it applies in Scotland.
Where a complete list of amending instruments cannot be established, the answer says so rather than presenting a partial list as exhaustive.
